title: Sorted Manifest
description: The dispatch dashboard's data table needs to sort, filter, and paginate shipments correctly. Request a page of shipments sorted by price and confirm the results actually come back in that order.
successCondition: GET /api/tracking?sort=priceCents&order=asc&page=1&pageSize=5 returns 200 with an items array whose priceCents values are non-decreasing, and total/page/pageSize fields matching the request.
hints: You'll need to be logged in — any role can list tracking data, but customers only see their own shipments.
Valid sort fields and the response shape are documented in docs/api/tracking.md.
